HDFC Bank Appoints Anup Bagchi as New CEO Amid Stock Outlook Discussion

HDFC Bank has appointed Anup Bagchi as its new Chief Executive Officer. This development comes as the bank's stock outlook is being discussed, with analysts like Kranthi Bathini weighing in on the implications of the appointment. Bagchi is described as an 'outsider' CEO for India's $110 billion HDFC Bank, a change that follows a period of upheaval for the institution.
